listing.name: ESPN NFL 2K5 Native PC
listing.summary: Play ESPN NFL 2K5 on Windows using upstream setup and your own original Xbox game.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are on hold pending review of whether the bundled in-game broadcast graphics reuse art from the original Xbox game. Use the upstream setup guide with a copy you have permission to use.

steps.title: Prepare your Xbox game
steps.instruction: Use an ISO or XISO from your own original retail Xbox disc, or an extracted disc folder that contains default.xbe and vc_53450030. Keep the original in a separate folder you control.

steps.title: Run upstream setup on Windows
steps.instruction: Use NFL2K5-PC-Setup.exe from the linked v0.6.1-hotfix release on 64-bit Windows 10 or 11. Choose a folder you can write to and select your extracted disc folder or an ISO/XISO and separate extraction destination. Setup links the extracted game folder through original/disc. Skip optional mod installation for a base-game setup.

steps.title: Start the installed game
steps.instruction: After setup, use the ESPN NFL 2K5 Native PC Start menu shortcut, or start NFL2K5.exe from its installation folder. Leave the linked Xbox game data in place.

warnings: Keep a separate copy of your saves before changing releases or importing a save. PS2 save conversion is experimental.
The upstream build contains recompiled game code. Distribution permission for that code is unverified.

references.title: Keep the active player profile
references.instruction: Preserve saves, mods and Music in your installation folder. Settings, caches and logs default to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NFL2K5-PC. If you deliberately use portable.txt beside NFL2K5.exe, keep the settings in that writable installation folder too. Back up your files before changing the installation.
